title: LockBit 5 Ransomware Gang Claims Attack on Italian Municipality of Robecco sul Naviglio
content_md:
Ransomware gang LockBit 5 has claimed an attack on the Municipality of Robecco sul Naviglio (MI). The Italian municipality in the province of Milan was targeted by the LockBit 5 ransomware group, which listed the victim on its leak site. The attack highlights the continued targeting of local government entities by ransomware operators. Details on the scope of data compromised and operational impact have not been publicly disclosed.
